summary: Fetch graph.json and fill node and edge counts
description: The static page fetches graph.json and writes nodes.length and edges.length into #node-count and #edge-count. No 3D library.
scope: viewer.js calls fetch('graph.json') and sets #node-count and #edge-count via textContent
acceptanceCriteria: index.html loads viewer.js. viewer.js fetches graph.json and assigns data.nodes.length to #node-count and data.edges.length to #edge-count.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add a watcher or CLI unless this task explicitly requires it.

subtasks.title: Fetch JSON and update counts
subtasks.summary: File-content tests only. No browser. No 3D.

instructions: Write the failing test in tests/test_viewer_fetch.py first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_viewer_fetch.py -q and confirm failure.
Add viewer.js and the script tag in index.html.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_viewer_fetch.py -q and stop when it passes.
